name: Remix.Camera Companion Images
description: Preview or generate companion images through a local Remix.Camera bridge.
author: Remix.Camera

input.hint: Companion name used in returned chat markdown.

input.placeholder: Clearly adult companion with a consistent Remix.Camera visual profile.
input.hint: Optional stable visual identity for prompt adaptation.

examples.prompt: Preview a cozy couch selfie for Lily.
Generate a date-night image after I confirm.
Preview a couple vacation set with my uploaded reference.

command.description: Companion image command such as send-selfie, auto-selfie-from-chat, outfit-try-on, couple-photo, couples-vacation, date-night, daily-life-snap, or private-snap.

prompt.description: Short image request or scene description.

chatText.description: Recent chat context for auto-selfie or daily-life snaps.

sourceImageUrl.description: Public source image URL for outfit or source-image workflows.

userReferenceImageUrl.description: Public user reference photo URL for couple workflows.

userConsent.description: Affirmative consent for user-in-image workflows. Use yes only when explicit.

yes.description: Set true only after explicit confirmation to spend a generation.

preview.description: Set true to force a dry-run preview.
